thesis: Causal, role, retrospective, prospective and legal responsibility must be distinguished.

ideas.statement: Allocate obligations through control, knowledge, role, risk contribution and remedial capacity; emergency help differs from fair later cost allocation and guilt differs from repair.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The framework is normative, not an empirical formula; capable helpers cannot owe endless labor, collective obligations require named decision points, and constrained consent may retain residual duty.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The framework is normative, not an empirical formula; capable helpers cannot owe endless labor, collective obligations require named decision points, and constrained consent may retain residual duty.

audit.notes: All batch units read; findings’ limits and distinctions preserved.
